method: scripts/tts_measure_rest.py in the running TTS, spawned at x 46-78 z -48/-64 (clear of the mat), settled, read, destroyed. boundsSize/boundsCenterOffset are collider bounds; visualNormalized* are getVisualBoundsNormalized (mesh). profiles.method: Physics.cast rays against the piece spawned Locked at rotY 0 at the clear corner (x 46-78, z -48/-64), then destroyed: straight down on a 0.1in grid over the cell (heights above the piece's bottom; -1 = no hit), and horizontally from the cell centre at 0.8, 1.4 and 2.0in above the bottom (distance to the first wall face). Collider geometry, not the mesh.
